critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage and visible focus pass for all header and thesis controls; touch-target checks report no violations; reduced-motion produces zero active animations; tablet/desktop have no section overflow. However, contrast remains unverified with 24 serious incomplete nodes in #thesis at every viewport and 14–26 in the header, including badges, animated headline words, body copy, CTAs, and navigation. Mobile also reports section scrollWidth 435px versus a 390px viewport, while much of the horizontally scrolling header is clipped from view. No measured screen-reader/semantic reading-order evidence is provided.
critique.fix: Resolve and manually measure contrast against the rendered gradient for every flagged text/control state, meeting WCAG AA; remove the mobile section’s excess scroll width; ensure the header scroller exposes clear touch/keyboard affordances and keeps focused items visible; then provide screen-reader landmark, heading, accessible-name, and reading-order test evidence.
